text.insert: The serialized materializer in apps/server/src/core/knowledge/background converts claimed evidence into the project knowledge stores and graph publication path. It stages output, verifies provenance, accepts it once, records the resulting knowledge revision, and only then marks the job succeeded.

Idempotency is keyed to stable source evidence and accepted output identity, so recovery can replay a claim without publishing the same fact twice. Publication preserves job, attempt, source, input revision, output revision, event, operation, and trace lineage. The implementation realizes
